title: Hellhound (3)
documented_limits: Bloody Mamba is retained as a scoped recovered-English fallback; current Fandom retrieval describes black mambas generically but exposes no dedicated formal species entry.
Chinese does not place the snakes in Le Rogue Mountain in Chapter 3; that MTL-only location was excluded.
Current Fandom retrieval does not verify Fang Castle for the Chinese descriptive nursery-castle reference; the MTL proper name was not forced.
Chinese first shows venom on exposed fangs and later says the fangs had already been removed by next-day inspection; both temporal statements are preserved without inventing the removal event.
